context.policy_one_liner: Clarity Act立法预期仍不明朗：已核列表截至10/1，9/15程序票49–50失败；Witt10/15离任，后续完整议程及新通过概率未核；未核到新增政府买币或储备地位改变；9/16委员会推进是既有进展，Congress完整后续进度本次未核；未核实Trump相关方实际清仓；公司净增持、解除抵押、匿名转账或杠杆持仓均不能直接视作内幕交易者出清；BNY已扩展欧盟机构托管，渣打新加坡仍为有监管前提的计划；服务采用增强，但不能直接计作BTC新增买盘
context.opinion_one_liner: 长期采用观点仍偏积极，短期判断分化：Garrett10/15在跌破82,500美元后仍谨慎看多并偏好BTC，Tom Lee10/5主张逢低买入，Schiff10/14继续主张转向黄金。较上期，Vitalik10/15转向zkEVM安全验证，Witt10/15离任成为政策人事变化，Galaxy10/9同时强调结构改善与流动性、杠杆风险；未核到普遍多空反转
context.verify_1_strategic_reserve: 本次独立检索未核到政府新增市场买币或改变战略储备地位的明确原始证据。重新打开众议院金融服务委员会9/16公告，H.R.8957以28–21获委员会推进；这是此前进展，不能刷新成10月立法完成。Congress逐项进度页本次未成功读取，故不声称已穷尽所有后续程序。来源：https://financialservices.house.gov/calendar/eventsingle.aspx?EventID=411219
context.verify_2_trump_clearance: 本次未取得Trump家族或相关交易者本月已大举清仓BTC的原始证据。Riot解除抵押没有披露等额出售；Lookonchain的匿名杠杆仓位与Whale Alert的USDC往返转账也不能作为具名现货清仓证据。已核Metaplanet的Q3卖出10,000并买入11,000 BTC，是净增1,000，不能误写成净清仓。来源：https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1167419/000110465926111003/riot-20260921x8k.htm；https://contents.xj-storage.jp/xcontents/33500/4b5f0c2e/ab52/4d40/9d89/e2aa6e3f3524/140120261005546274.pdf
context.verify_3_institutional_entry: BNY10/8宣布把数字资产托管扩展至欧盟部分机构，依据MiCA框架，覆盖BTC、ETH等资产；渣打同日宣布拟为新加坡机构与合格企业客户提供加密资产、稳定币及代币化资产托管，仍须满足监管要求。前者是服务扩展，后者是带条件计划，两者均未披露可计量的新增BTC现货购买。来源：https://www.bny.com/corporate/global/en/about-us/newsroom/press-release/bny-expands-digital-asset-custody-platform-in-europe.html；https://www.sc.com/en/press-release/standard-chartered-advances-into-digital-asset-custody-offering-in-singapore/
context.verify_4_clarity_passage_probability: 本次重新读取参议院cloture列表，页面自身截止日期仍为10/1，记载9/15推进Clarity审议的程序票49–50失败，非最终法案否决。10/15 Witt宣布离任，Sacks确认其此前推动委员会与议程工作的贡献；未取得新通过票或可靠量化通过概率。行政监管提案不能替代国会成法，且10/1之后完整议程仍未验证。来源：https://www.senate.gov/legislative/cloture/119.htm；https://x.com/patrickjwitt/status/2110579591073104355

Fission Raises $10M Series A Led by Pantera Capital to Bring Liquidity to Digital Private Markets
News provided by
Fission Labs
Oct 15, 2026, 07:30 ET
Share this article
Share to
X
Share this article
Share to
X
Pantera Capital leads the round with participation from Circle Ventures, New Form, gumi Cryptos Capital, Borderless Capital and Ari Rubenstein, CEO of GTS
Tokenization
is rapidly moving private-market funds onto digital rails, but liquidity has not kept pace. Traditional fund structuring forces investors to face long settlement and redemption cycles. Fission helps close that gap by giving eligible investors faster access to capital.
Funding will expand Fission's liquidity capacity, support a broader range of tokenized private-market and semi-liquid funds, and deepen integrations across the digital investment ecosystem.
Fission has already processed millions of dollars in redemptions, demonstrating growing demand for more flexible liquidity across tokenized private-market funds.
NEW YORK
,
Oct. 15, 2026
/PRNewswire/ -- Fission, a blockchain-enabled financial technology company building liquidity infrastructure for tokenized investment funds, today announced it has closed a $10 million Series A funding round led by Pantera Capital and backed by a group of investors spanning traditional finance and digital assets.
Investment funds are rapidly moving on-chain.
Tokenization
has already transformed how fund interests can be issued, distributed and settled, but much of the underlying market structure remains unchanged. Tokenized funds still rely on periodic redemption windows, limited secondary liquidity and restrictive financing structures.
Fission is building the liquidity layer designed to change that.
The company enables investor liquidity for supported tokenized fund products, allowing eligible holders to access capital without waiting for traditional fund redemption cycles. Fission supports a growing universe of tokenized funds across asset classes including private credit, alternatives and other institutional investment products. The company has already processed millions of dollars in transactions and is expanding its capacity through both traditional and on-chain sources of capital.
"Putting funds on-chain is only the beginning," said Jonathan Shaffer, Founder and CEO of Fission. "The real promise of
tokenization
is creating fundamentally better markets around these assets: broader distribution, continuous liquidity and the ability to use fund interests as collateral in lending markets. Whether a fund is private or simply constrained by traditional liquidity structures, Fission is building the technology that makes those assets more liquid, transferable and useful across financial markets."
Fission's platform is purpose-built for institutional and permissioned markets, with infrastructure designed around the investor eligibility, transfer restrictions and compliance requirements governing regulated investment products. This allows Fission to bring on-chain liquidity to these assets while preserving the controls required by securities markets.
The new capital will support Fission's continued expansion across asset coverage, liquidity capacity and institutional integrations.
"Investment funds are moving onto digital rails and liquidity is one of the critical pieces required for that transition to reach its full potential," said Franklin Bi, General Partner at Pantera Capital. "Fission is building infrastructure that will help transform tokenized funds from representations of traditional products with legacy constraints into fundamentally more liquid and productive assets."
The round adds Pantera Capital, Circle Ventures, Borderless Capital and Ari Rubenstein to Fission's investor base, alongside existing backers including New Form, gumi Cryptos Capital, Anthony Scaramucci, Manhattan Venture Partners, Reflexive Capital and Lattice Capital.
For more on Fission's infrastructure and its vision for the future of on-chain investment funds, visit
